deployments_detail.use: "VOCALOID:AI" voice synthesis, AI instrument sound synthesis, AI-assisted piano ("Daredemo Piano"), AI piano tuning

VOCALOID:AI singing voice synthesis engine, using deep learning to model a singer's tone and expression, shipped in the commercial VOCALOID6 vocal production software (and demonstrated in the Hibari Misora reproduction project). [Yamaha VOCALOID:AI (proprietary)]

AI Music Ensemble Technology: an AI accompanist that analyzes a human performer's notes and motion in real time to predict tempo/timing and play along as an ensemble partner (also branded AI Project YOO). [Yamaha (proprietary)]

Music:AI in-vehicle sound optimization technology that uses AI trained on Yamaha's tuning expertise to automatically optimize cabin acoustics, per-song music optimization, and listener personalization for automotive audio systems. [Yamaha Music:AI (proprietary)]

AI-powered text-to-sample generator integrated into the SEQTRAK music creation app, letting creators generate sound samples from text prompts; entered technical verification with hands-on trials at NAMM 2026. [Boomy Corporation (generative AI)]

ADECIA conferencing system's Advanced AI Denoiser (in the RM-CR remote conference processor) that removes background noise such as typing, paper rustling and pen clicks in real time during meetings. [Yamaha (proprietary DSP/AI)]

AI system that captures a dancer's body movements via sensors and translates them in real time into piano performance, demonstrated with dancer Kaiji Moriyama controlling a Disklavier player piano. [Yamaha (proprietary)]

Enterprise master data management across 200+ global systems using Informatica's AI-powered MDM (CLAIRE AI) to provide consistent, high-quality data for customer-centric manufacturing and analytics. [Informatica (CLAIRE AI / MDM)]

Global logistics transformation using the Domo AI/data platform to consolidate maritime shipping data, automate carrier performance evaluation, and enable early detection of tariff/weather disruptions across 40+ factories, warehouses and sales sites. [Domo]
deployments_detail.value: ~200 hours of manual aggregation work reduced annually
